<thought>We need a template whose forward reaction breaks a halide (C‑Cl) and forms a C‑N bond, i.e., creates a primary amine. Using the available functional groups, we’ll search for templates that break “halide” and form “primary amines”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
